description: A web interface for visualizing and browsing database contents. It provides a sidebar for database and table selection, and a main content area showing table data with interactive features like cell expansion.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-calling loadDatabases.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates the HTML for displaying table data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates table cell HTML, handling long text, nulls, and objects with clickable expansion.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
